stories.title: Minister sets out national care service plan for Wales with £3.6m extra
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has put an extra £3.6 million behind its plans for a national care service, but could not say when the national social care academy at the centre of the plans will open. stories.title: Platis Gialos and the Water Taxi Beaches of Mykonos
stories.summary: Platis Gialos and the Water Taxi Beaches of Mykonos form a connected stretch of coastline linked by the island’s water taxi network. Platis Gialos sits along Mykonos’ southern coast, functioning as a central departure point for boats reaching several nearby beaches within minutes. stories.title: Unauthorised absence rises in Flintshire secondary schools, Welsh Government figures show
stories.summary: Secondary school attendance in Flintshire fell last year while the average across Wales held steady, Welsh Government figures show. Secondary-age pupils in the county attended 89.6 per cent of school sessions in 2025/26, down from 90.3 per cent the year before. stories.title: Second gas peaking plant proposed at Deeside Industrial Park power station
stories.summary: Plans have been drawn up to add 11 more gas engines at a Deeside Industrial Park power station, which would take the site to 22. Deeside Power (UK) Ltd wants to build a second 49.9 megawatt peaking plant at Deeside Power Station on Weighbridge Road, next to a previously approved plant of the same size.
